primary.title: The Diary of Thomas A. Edison
primary.author: Thomas Edison
primary.rationale: A compilation of Edison's personal diaries, offering direct insight into his thoughts, experiments, and daily life. While the original diaries are in archives, published versions are likely to be found in digital libraries.

primary.title: Thomas Edison: His Life and Inventions
primary.author: Thomas Edison
primary.rationale: This work, co-authored by Edison himself, provides a narrative of his life and inventions, offering a firsthand account of his career and perspectives. It is a foundational text for understanding his self-representation.

primary.title: The Papers of Thomas A. Edison
primary.author: Thomas Edison
primary.rationale: A multi-volume collection of Edison's correspondence, notebooks, and other documents. While extensive, individual volumes or selections might be digitized and available.

secondary.title: Edison: A Biography
secondary.author: Edmund Morris
secondary.rationale: A highly regarded and comprehensive biography of Thomas Edison, written by a Pulitzer Prize-winning author. It draws on extensive archival research and offers a critical and detailed account of his life and work.

secondary.title: Thomas Edison: The World's Greatest Inventor
secondary.author: Genevieve B. Johnson
secondary.rationale: A scholarly biography that examines Edison's contributions and impact on society, focusing on his inventive process and business acumen. It is a significant academic work on the subject.

secondary.title: Inventing Thomas Edison: Practical Life of a Visionary
secondary.author: Jill Jonnes
secondary.rationale: This book provides a nuanced look at Edison's life, emphasizing the practical aspects of his inventions and his role in shaping modern American life. It is a well-researched academic study.

suggestions.notes: Primary source availability on digital platforms can vary. The 'Papers of Thomas A. Edison' is a monumental archival project, and while full digitization is ongoing, specific volumes or selections are more likely to be found online than the entire collection.
